questions.prompt: True or false: “Marie Skłodowska-Curie discovered stepfather.”

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Its _____ were not understood at that time.”

hints.nudge: The missing word names more than one thing. Read the whole sentence and ask which of them the article is talking about.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Marie Curie article.

questions.proof: Its effects were not understood at that time.

questions.prompt: Which of these people was born first?

hints.nudge: Think about which one is the oldest. The dates in the Timeline run from the earliest to the latest.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the Timeline: every entry shows its date.

questions.proof: Born: Marie Curie in 1867; Tu Youyou in 1930; Arno Allan Penzias in 1933; Brian May in 1947.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “She was the first _____ to win two Nobel Prizes.”

hints.nudge: The missing word names one thing, not an action. The words on each side of the gap show what kind of thing fits.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Marie Curie article.

questions.proof: She was the first person to win two Nobel Prizes.
